wall_bound_use_sites.fact: CLI wall-bound-s defaults450; run accepts60..7200 wall seconds. Existing CLI does not accept a bound above7200.
Bootstrap marker wait has its own25s deadline plus overall elapsed bound+35 check from the host monotonic start.
Host foreground-client/SDK-fault monitor checks overall elapsed bound+35; existing ROS-exit cleanup grace remains separate.
WSL owner.start receives bound+30; supervisor passes that value to systemd RuntimeMaxSec. This is owned Linux process containment, not simulated time.
Windows Job runner receives timeout=bound, validates1..7200, uses monotonic wall deadline, then closes its owned tree and records residual PIDs.
The CLI bound is not forwarded into SDK/ROS control arguments or fleet preparation. Preparation has no wall-bound/order-count override; simulated inputs come from the frozen bundle.

separate_limits.conclusion: Changing a supported prelaunch host bound changes external resource/runtime containment only in these use sites. It does not rewrite workload horizon, simulated action deadlines, lease/path TTL, physics or control gates. Independent wall limits still apply.

source_config_values_not_reverified_as_l.fact: Workload horizon1800s is compiled independently and must be below max_sim_time_s.
Source SDK config max_sim_time_s2100, max_wall_time_s10800, authorization_ttl_s0.5 are separate fields.
Source ROS runtime max_wall_time_s5400, startup_sim_allowance_s300 and chunk_timeout_s180 are independent of the pair CLI bound.

separate_limits.inflight: No running bound was changed or extended; no rerun/stop/resource authorization decision was made.

three_order_support.verdict: Supported input shape through general bundle API/CLI; no order-count override in the frozen full-stage wrapper. Source-based finding only, not an executed3-order preparation.

public_api.fact: Reads authored source configuration before creating a NEW output, copies inputs, generates session and hashes bundle files.

requirements.fact: Exactly four configured starting robot IDs are required; orders must be nonempty with distinct order/payload IDs and ready times inside the unchanged horizon. There is no exact-four-order check, so three valid orders are allowed by this source boundary.
Material declarations must match the mission order IDs exactly; a three-order input must have corresponding material declarations before preparation, not just truncate generated session.json.

Session/workload digest and bundle source/file hashes are derived and verified. Existing radius, route, safety/control inputs can remain unchanged in the authored source configuration; prepared/provenance files must not be patched afterward.

wrapper_limit.fact: Full-stage prepare always uses source_root/configs/factory-fleet4, with archive/snapshot proof. It exposes runtime-profile only, not config-dir or order-count. Current source profile contains four orders. General bundle CLI support is not a ready full-stage3-order override.

three_order_support.experiment_boundary: A three-order four-vehicle workload would be a different explicit experiment with newly authored inputs and identity. It cannot convert a failed/incomplete four-order result into passed. No such experiment was selected or prepared.

known_observation.scope: Asynchronous periodic World-clock state observations of the whole running scene; includes navigation, sensing and rendering. Not an isolated performance benchmark or a completion-time guarantee.
known_observation.limits: Periodic whole-scene intervals and a single GPU sample do not guarantee completion time or identify an isolated bottleneck. No fresh runtime query or outcome decision was performed.

missing_input.explanation: session.json is generated at output/session.json by prepare_bundle (factory_ops/fleet_transport.py:219), not a present source config. No invented SHA or active-stage substitute read.

limits: Readonly source facts; no functional3-order acceptance claim, completion-time guarantee,80-percent judgment or operating decision.
Root retains actual034 outcome and any later resource/experiment choice after verified closure.
